collection.title: Ford Focus Saloon 2011 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Focus Saloon 2015 Onwards version requires a 29" wiper blade for both drivers and passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. Please Note - Some brands recommend 2 x 28" front blades which are slightly shorter than the originals.
